projects.title: Flutter Pokedex
projects.description: A Pokédex App built with Flutter that lets users explore Pokémon from different generations. The app fetches detailed Pokémon data from the PokéAPI, including images, stats, abilities, evolution chains, and more.

projects.description: This is my very first React project, which helped me land my first job in the industry. It was my first introduction to React and libraries like Material UI. Despite its rough look, it holds sentimental value and was a key step in my journey.

projects.title: Portfolio

experience.title: Fullstack/Mobile Developer
experience.description:
I worked as a mobile and full-stack developer, focusing on Flutter and React Native for the company’s first mobile app. I optimized the app for performance and user experience.
On the web side, I used React and state management tools like Redux to maintain smooth data flow. In Flutter, I worked with state management solutions like Provider and Riverpod to ensure scalability.
I developed custom APIs with Django for seamless interaction between frontend and backend systems. I also implemented user authentication and WebSockets for real-time communication.
I contributed to the R&D of the company’s second product, providing technical solutions to improve functionality. Additionally, I managed app deployments and updates on the iOS App Store and Google Play Store.
